summary:
医疗AI周报（仅据输入条目；不纳入数字健康、生命科学与药物条目）

一、研究进展
1. 卒中影像：DFE-Net以可学习模糊隶属场表征空间不确定性，在多中心CT队列6650例、8873幅图像上联合分类卒中并定位病灶，CT AUC 0.974、F1 0.897，MRI AUC 0.978，CT病灶定位对照专家标注Dice 0.70[1]。视网膜影像卒中早筛分型研究提出记忆引导互信息优化方法[37]；脑血管DSA综述覆盖2D、3D旋转与4D DSA，并指出证据分散于不同任务、数据集与验证策略[31]。
2. 心血管影像与心电：回顾性多中心预后研究显示，AI衍生射血分数对死亡的预测略优于临床医生分割所得射血分数，作者认为需前瞻性研究验证一线应用[7]；相关述评指出CMR成本高、操作者短缺等限制[26]。心电基础模型诊断评分被用于构建可解释低左室射血分数检测框架，作者称尚需人群筛查与国际大队列验证[24]。心衰综述介绍AI心电图模型用于结构性心脏病机会性筛查，以及心电图联合超声识别ATTR心肌淀粉样变等表型，强调前瞻性评估与配套工作流设计[29]。
3. 病理与计算病理：乳腺DCE-MRI分割框架以测量保真度为主要终点，内部测试与DUKE共521例配对病例，肿瘤体积中位误差9.7%、ICC 0.97，外部源留出分层Dice中位0.823[3]。舌鳞癌神经侵犯弱监督模型基于两中心629例、1511张H&E全切片，并设192例外部测试队列[15]。HER2状态AI判读系统综述纳入51项研究，其中14项进入诊断准确性合并分析[22]；COSAS 2024挑战赛聚焦计算病理跨器官、跨扫描仪腺癌分割的域泛化[11]。预印本分析130万张H&E切片、25个器官、25.7万患者，病理基础模型识别性别AUROC 0.828、年龄组0.733、自报种族0.662，诊断分层后信号减弱但仍存在[41]。
4. 大模型与临床文档：膀胱癌mpMRI报告管理建议多中心评测按TRIPOD-LLM使用三院590份报告、两种输入条件、21240条医生1—5分评分，输入语言与评分关联因模型而异[4]。糖尿病肾病出院指导对比评估纳入101例住院患者，比较低年资住院医师独立撰写与DeepSeek-V3.2辅助生成，并按CKD分期分析获益[30]。环境AI scribe评估分析54项研究，归纳10个维度、40项指标和96种操作化方式，文书效率/时间最常测，安全与结局最少[35]；两款商用环境AI记录工具的UCLA单中心随机试验方案计划374名门诊医生1:1比较可用性、文书负担、EHR时间、开单编码支持与患者沟通体验[38]。
5. 其他方法与基准：SynSight用合成数据训练分割与分类模型解读HIV与COVID-19快速诊断试纸，HIV灵敏度98%、特异度99%，COVID-19准确率最高99%[8]。MambaSleepCVD用整夜多导睡眠图预测长期心血管风险，在SHHS队列验证，性能与基线相当或更优[19]。PhysioWave-T小波基础模型压缩令牌序列，EEG模型30M参数，9项EEG指标中8项领先并优于LUNA-L[33]。胸片ReCaRL以可靠性加权与置信门控处理多标签噪声标注[44]。耳镜OtoScan合并三个公开数据集4763张图像、12个临床类别，聚焦非专科医生转诊决策[50]。预印本Neuro-VL在近百万例常规临床神经影像上训练，内部及国际数据集上优于通用与专科模型[27]；NPCBench含4777个知识与问诊条目及100例患者、417项计分诊疗任务[32]；Curiosity-0826-4B可零样本预测临床事件，实验室值预测MAE较前版降低18—46%，儿童哮喘新诊断AUROC 0.742—0.785，镰状细胞危象AUROC 0.820—0.847、低于成人0.915[43]。tEHR用自然语言描述EHR事件，在MIMIC-IV四任务与CPRD胰腺癌预测外部评测[39]。ContextMRI利用扫描元数据条件化改进压缩感知MRI重建[20]。权重空间编程让大模型直接生成医学图像分类器权重，在7个任务4种模态上与零样本MedSigLIP及常规训练模型比较[42]。通用生成式AI合成医学影像用于训练与审计，合成数据模型在真实数据上外部验证，肺炎任务AUROC 0.877（n=14863）[48]。脑龄估计框架在4346例认知正常成人训练，外部测试集315例与209例、另用954例临床队列，脑龄差与淀粉样PET、白质高信号、卒中史及临床恶化相关[2]。两步深度学习用美国时序电子病历同时评估念珠菌血症与死亡风险，作者称需前瞻性研究验证[12]。口腔癌多模态AI系统综述纳入2015—2025年82项研究，认为多模态在诊断准确性、AUC与生存预测上总体优于单模态[18]；肺动脉高压AI综述覆盖筛查、诊断、分型、风险分层与预后预测[46]。

二、落地监管
1. Tempus AI的心电AI工具用于检测二尖瓣反流已获FDA许可；输入仅提供标题，正文未提供，细节未知[25]。
2. UMBRELLA-P在6国7家大学医院前瞻观察约1万例疑似卒中或TIA患者，覆盖院前、院内与院后全流程数据；为新注册、尚无结果，未报告任何发现[28]。
3. EvoXRare为实用型随机试验注册，计划纳入7万例急诊与重症患者，评估AI胸片报告草稿与高危提示能否减少重要病变漏诊；注册信息显示尚未开始招募，暂无结果[45]。
4. 口腔癌AI筛查评论指出，MeMoSA等工具几乎仅在亚洲人群验证，生理性口腔色素沉着按种族而异且非病理，呼吁部署前开展色素分层验证[14]。AI智能体安全社论列举过去一年公开报道的AI智能体入侵技术平台、统计门户及篡改个人数据的系统安全事件，呼吁重视AI智能体安全[40]。
5. 一篇分析ClinicalTrials.gov注册介入性临床试验中AI使用情况的同行评审论文，输入仅有标题信息[49]。

三、产业动态
本周期输入未提供符合上述范围的产业交易、融资或并购条目。

四、限制与待核实
1. 多项研究为预印本，需同行评审与进一步外部验证，包括Neuro-VL[27]、NPCBench[32]、PhysioWave-T[33]、环境AI scribe评估[35]、tEHR[39]、病理人口学信息映射[41]、权重空间编程[42]、Curiosity-0826-4B[43]、ReCaRL[44]、LLM生成病历对下游模型影响[47]、通用生成式AI合成医学影像[48]、OtoScan[50]。
2. 注册研究尚无结果：UMBRELLA-P[28]与EvoXRare[45]均未报告发现，不能据此判断效果。
3. 部分条目信息不足：Tempus AI心电AI获FDA许可仅见标题、正文未提供[25]；糖尿病视网膜病变多视图图融合与重建研究仅给出标题与作者，未见摘要[34]；开放缝合技能视觉评估挑战赛细节有限[36]；注册介入性临床试验AI使用分析仅有标题[49]。
4. 前瞻验证仍是明确限制：AI衍生EF预测死亡略优于医生EF，但作者认为需前瞻性研究验证一线应用[7]；念珠菌血症两步模型作者明确尚需前瞻性研究确认[12]；低LVEF心电可解释框架尚需人群筛查与国际大队列验证[24]；心衰AI综述强调需前瞻性评估与工作流设计[29]。
5. 人机协作风险需关注：48名医生随机对照研究显示，心脏听诊AI可靠性逐步下降时，医生诊断准确率随之下降，即使被强制先独立判断；医生信心下降快于对AI信任下降[9]。JAMIA观点提出“先口述后揭示”，并区分技能退化、从未形成技能与错误内化三类风险[16]。预印本指出LLM撰写病历的“膨胀”与诊断过度记录会影响后续读取同一病历的LLM，提示读写闭环部署风险[47]。
6. 评估与证据仍碎片化：环境AI scribe的54项研究将40项指标以96种方式操作化[35]；口腔癌AI筛查需按色素分层验证[14]；病理切片人口学信息可识别性提示公平与隐私审计需求[41]。
7. 成本证据待核实：MedCity News报道NEJM一项研究称AI生成照护计划费用可能远高于医生开具方案，但报道未给出样本量与设计细节[21]。
8. 多篇为综述、述评或挑战赛总结，不提供原始研究数据，包括脑血管DSA综述[31]、口腔癌多模态系统综述[18]、上下文学习综述[23]、肺动脉高压AI综述[46]等。

items.title: Learning uncertainty fields for joint brain stroke diagnosis and intrinsic lesion localization in CT and MRI
items.zh_title: 模糊不确定性场联合脑卒中诊断与病灶定位
items.summary: DFE-Net 以可学习模糊隶属场表征空间不确定性，在多中心 CT 与 MRI 队列上联合分类卒中并定位病灶。
key_points: 多中心CT队列6650例、8873幅图像
CT AUC 0.974、F1 0.897；MRI AUC 0.978
CT病灶定位对照专家标注Dice 0.70
items.reason: 多中心大样本影像队列并有独立MRI队列验证，属重要档；回顾性且未报临床结局
items.abstract: Early stroke changes can be difficult to detect and localize on neuroimaging, particularly when lesion boundaries are indistinct. We developed the Dynamic Fuzzy Encoder Network (DFE-Net), which uses learnable fuzzy membership fields to represent spatial uncertainty and jointly classify stroke and localize lesions. We evaluated the model on a multicentre computed tomography (CT) cohort comprising 6650 patients and 8873 images and a separate magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) cohort comprising 67 patients and 615 images. Training and testing were performed separately within each modality. DFE-Net achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.974 and an F1 score of 0.897 on CT, and corresponding values of 0.978 and 0.879 on MRI. In the CT cohort, lesion localization against expert annotations yielded a Dice score of 0.70. MRI localization was assessed using gradient-derived pseudo-targets because expert lesion masks were unavailable. Expected calibration error was ~0.022 in both cohorts, and the model contained 0.20 million parameters. These results support joint diagnosis and spatial localization with a compact model, while prospective validation and expert-annotated MRI evaluation remain necessary.
items.zh_abstract: 早期卒中改变在神经影像上可能难以检测和定位，尤其是当病灶边界不清晰时。我们开发了动态模糊编码器网络（Dynamic Fuzzy Encoder Network，DFE-Net），其使用可学习的模糊隶属度场来表示空间不确定性，并联合进行卒中分类和病灶定位。我们在一个包含6650例患者和8873幅图像的多中心计算机断层扫描（computed tomography，CT）队列，以及一个包含67例患者和615幅图像的独立磁共振成像（magnetic resonance imaging，MRI）队列上评估了该模型。训练和测试均在每种模态内分别进行。DFE-Net在CT上达到受试者工作特征曲线下面积0.974和F1分数0.897，在MRI上相应值为0.978和0.879。在CT队列中，与专家标注相比，病灶定位的Dice分数为0.70。由于没有专家病灶掩膜，MRI定位使用梯度衍生的伪目标进行评估。两个队列中的期望校准误差均约为0.022，模型包含20万个参数。这些结果支持使用紧凑模型进行联合诊断和空间定位，但仍需前瞻性验证和专家标注的MRI评估。

items.title: Evaluation of a Rapid and Practical Deep Learning Framework for T1-weighted MRI-based Brain Age Estimation.
items.zh_title: 快速实用深度学习框架用于T1 MRI脑龄估计
items.summary: 回顾性研究用免费Python工具构建脑龄估计框架，在多个外部队列验证脑龄差与痴呆诊断等指标的关联。
key_points: 训练队列4346例认知正常成人，两个外部测试集
外部测试集315例与209例，另用954例临床队列
脑龄差与淀粉样PET、白质高信号、卒中史及临床恶化相关
items.reason: 同行评审、大样本且多外部队列验证并关联临床结局，属重要档
items.abstract: [Radiology. Artificial intelligence] Purpose To develop and evaluate a rapid brain-age estimation framework using freely available Python tools and assess the clinical relevance of brain-age gap (BAG). Materials and Methods In this retrospective study conducted from March 2025 to August 2026, T1-weighted MR images from cohorts of cognitively normal adults (n = 4,346) were divided into training, validation, and internal test sets; two cohorts (n = 315 and 209) served as external test sets. Clinical evaluation used the BICWALZS cohort (n = 954; cognitively normal and various dementias). Preprocessing used freely available Python tools only. The model was trained to predict chronological age as the reference standard. Associations of the residualized BAG with diagnosis, amyloid PET positivity, white matter hyperintensity (WMH) severity, stroke history, and longitudinal clinical worsening were evaluated using ANCOVA, logistic regression, and Cox models. Results The development cohort included 4,346 cognitively normal adults (mean age, 47.0 ± 21.2 years; 2,414 women). Chronological age prediction yielded R2 = 0.95 and MAE, 3.76 years in the internal test set and R2 = 0.69-0.90 and MAE, 4.82-5.15 years in external test sets. The residualized BAG increased across diagnostic groups (P < .001) and was associated with WMH severity (odds ratio [OR], 1.64; P < .001) and stroke history (OR, 1.46; P < .001), but not with amyloid positivity after full adjustment (P = .17), and predicted longitudinal clinical worsening (HR, 1.92). Conclusion The framework accurately predicted age, while residualized BAG was associated with diagnosis, cerebrovascular burden, and longitudinal clinical worsening. © RSNA, 2026.
items.zh_abstract: [Radiology. Artificial intelligence]【目的】开发并评估一个使用可免费获取的 Python 工具的快速脑龄估计框架，并评估脑龄差（brain-age gap，BAG）的临床相关性。【材料与方法】在这项于2025年3月至2026年8月开展的回顾性研究中，将来自认知正常成人队列（n = 4,346）的 T1 加权 MR 图像分为训练集、验证集和内部测试集；两个队列（n = 315 和 209）作为外部测试集。临床评估使用 BICWALZS 队列（n = 954；认知正常及各类痴呆）。预处理仅使用可免费获取的 Python 工具。模型训练以预测实际年龄作为参考标准。使用 ANCOVA、logistic 回归和 Cox 模型评估残差化 BAG 与诊断、淀粉样蛋白 PET 阳性、白质高信号（WMH）严重程度、卒中史及纵向临床恶化之间的关联。【结果】开发队列包括4,346名认知正常成人（平均年龄47.0 ± 21.2岁；女性2,414名）。实际年龄预测在内部测试集中得到 R2 = 0.95、MAE 为3.76岁，在外部测试集中得到 R2 = 0.69-0.90、MAE 为4.82-5.15岁。残差化 BAG 在各诊断组间升高（P < .001），并与 WMH 严重程度（比值比 [OR]，1.64；P < .001）和卒中史（OR，1.46；P < .001）相关，但在完全校正后与淀粉样蛋白阳性无关（P = .17），并可预测纵向临床恶化（HR，1.92）。【结论】该框架能准确预测年龄，而残差化 BAG 与诊断、脑血管负荷及纵向临床恶化相关。© RSNA，2026。

items.title: Measurement fidelity and external validation of automated breast DCE-MRI segmentation
items.zh_title: 乳腺DCE-MRI自动分割的测量保真度与外部验证
items.summary: 构建增强感知3D MedNeXt分割框架，以测量保真度为主要终点开展多队列与外部验证。
key_points: 内部测试与DUKE共521例配对病例
肿瘤体积中位误差9.7%，ICC 0.97
外部源留出分层Dice中位0.823
items.reason: 多队列外部验证并以测量保真度为主要终点，属重要档
items.abstract: Automated breast dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (DCE-MRI) segmentation could facilitate quantitative tumor measurement, but geometric overlap alone does not establish the fidelity of mask-derived measurements. We developed an enhancement-aware three-dimensional MedNeXt framework with gated skip fusion and boundary supervision and evaluated it in a retrospective multi-cohort design spanning locked internal testing, source-held-out assessment, retrospective external validation, and radiologist review. Measurement fidelity was the primary endpoint. Across 521 paired internal-test and DUKE cases, median errors were 9.7% for tumor volume, 1.8 mm for 3D maximum surface diameter, and 10.2% for operational enhancement-defined volume, with corresponding ICCs of 0.97, 0.80, and 0.97. Median Dice was 0.831 internally and 0.823 in the DUKE source-held-out stratum, and was 0.812 and 0.806 in the BC-MRI-SEG and public BreastDCEDL_AMBL retrospective external-validation cohorts, respectively, using the frozen checkpoint without external-label tuning. No major correction was required for 78 of 80 masks in the blinded two-reader review. In 276 paired response-analysis cases, AUROC was 0.732 with automatic geometry and 0.757 with expert geometry (difference, −0.025; 95% CI, −0.095 to 0.045); discrimination non-inferiority was not demonstrated. These findings support automated segmentation as a starting point for radiologist-supervised retrospective quantitative research within the evaluated cohorts, while distinguishing measurement fidelity from downstream predictive equivalence.
items.zh_abstract: 自动乳腺动态对比增强磁共振成像（DCE-MRI）分割可促进肿瘤定量测量，但仅几何重叠并不能确立掩膜衍生测量的保真度。我们开发了一个增强感知的三维 MedNeXt 框架，具有门控跳跃融合和边界监督，并在回顾性多队列设计中对其进行评估，涵盖锁定内部测试、源数据留出评估、回顾性外部验证和放射科医师审查。测量保真度是主要终点。在521例配对的内部测试和DUKE病例中，中位误差为肿瘤体积9.7%、三维最大表面直径1.8 mm、操作性增强定义体积10.2%，相应ICC分别为0.97、0.80和0.97。中位Dice在内部为0.831，在DUKE源数据留出层为0.823；在使用冻结检查点且未进行外部标签调优的情况下，在BC-MRI-SEG和公开BreastDCEDL_AMBL回顾性外部验证队列中分别为0.812和0.806。在盲法双读者审查中，80个掩膜中有78个无需重大修正。在276例配对反应分析病例中，自动几何的AUROC为0.732，专家几何为0.757（差异，−0.025；95% CI，−0.095至0.045）；未证明判别非劣效性。这些发现支持自动分割作为在所评估队列内由放射科医师监督的回顾性定量研究的起点，同时区分测量保真度与下游预测等效性。

items.title: Multicenter benchmarking of large language models for bladder cancer management recommendations from mpMRI reports
items.zh_title: 大模型生成膀胱癌mpMRI报告管理建议的多中心评测
items.summary: 按TRIPOD-LLM，用三家医院590份膀胱癌mpMRI报告回顾性评测9个大模型生成指南一致性建议的表现。
key_points: 三院590份报告，两种输入条件
21240条医生1-5分评分
输入语言与评分关联因模型而异
items.reason: 同行评审+三家医院外部验证，但为回顾性且以医生评分为终点，故取重要档下限
items.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can interpret radiology reports, but their ability to generate guideline-concordant recommendations from bladder cancer multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) reports remains uncertain. Following TRIPOD-LLM, we retrospectively evaluated nine API-accessed LLMs using 590 mpMRI reports from three hospitals under two input conditions: original Chinese reports and clinician-translated, quality-controlled English reports. Two physicians independently rated each model-generated recommendation on a 1–5 ordinal scale. We analyzed 21,240 ratings using patient-level random-intercept cumulative link mixed models, with paired Wilcoxon tests as secondary exploratory analyses. The association between input condition and physician rating differed across LLMs (likelihood-ratio chi-square = 683.05, df = 8, P < 0.001). Compared with original Chinese input, clinician-translated English input was associated with higher ratings for chatgpt-o3-pro (OR 2.79, 95% CI 2.29–3.41), deepseek-v4-flash (OR 1.46, 95% CI 1.19–1.81), claude-opus-4-7 (OR 3.07, 95% CI 2.47–3.82), and gpt-5.5 (OR 1.88, 95% CI 1.53–2.32), but with lower ratings for claude-sonnet-4-5 (OR 0.29, 95% CI 0.23–0.36; all Holm-adjusted P < 0.001). Four LLMs showed no clear input-condition difference. Center-specific contrasts also depended on input condition and were materially unchanged after adjustment for age, sex, pathological T stage, tumor grade, tumor number, and maximum lesion diameter. Inter-rater agreement was substantial (quadratic weighted kappa range, 0.621–0.743). Readability did not track physician-rated recommendation quality. These findings argue against clinician-translated English as a universal optimization strategy and support model-specific validation of input conditions before clinical deployment. LLM-generated recommendations from mpMRI reports are best positioned as clinician-supervised, imaging-based decision support rather than standalone treatment advice.
items.zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够解读放射学报告，但其从膀胱癌多参数MRI（mpMRI）报告生成符合指南建议的能力仍不确定。遵循TRIPOD-LLM，我们回顾性评估了九个通过API访问的LLMs，使用来自三家医院的590份mpMRI报告，在两种输入条件下：原始中文报告和经临床医生翻译、质量控制的英文报告。两名医生在1–5序数量表上独立对每个模型生成的建议进行评分。我们使用患者水平随机截距累积链接混合模型分析了21,240个评分，并以配对Wilcoxon检验作为次要探索性分析。输入条件与医生评分之间的关联在不同LLMs间存在差异（似然比卡方=683.05，df=8，P<0.001）。与原始中文输入相比，经临床医生翻译的英文输入与chatgpt-o3-pro（OR 2.79，95% CI 2.29–3.41）、deepseek-v4-flash（OR 1.46，95% CI 1.19–1.81）、claude-opus-4-7（OR 3.07，95% CI 2.47–3.82）和gpt-5.5（OR 1.88，95% CI 1.53–2.32）的更高评分相关，但与claude-sonnet-4-5的更低评分相关（OR 0.29，95% CI 0.23–0.36；所有Holm校正P<0.001）。四个LLMs未显示明确的输入条件差异。中心特异性对比也取决于输入条件，并且在调整年龄、性别、病理T分期、肿瘤分级、肿瘤数量和最大病灶直径后基本未改变。评分者间一致性相当高（二次加权kappa范围，0.621–0.743）。可读性并未与医生评定的建议质量相对应。这些发现反对将临床医生翻译的英文作为通用优化策略，并支持在临床部署前对输入条件进行模型特异性验证。来自mpMRI报告的LLM生成建议最适合定位为临床医生监督下的、基于影像的决策支持，而非独立的治疗建议。

items.abstract: Datopotamab deruxtecan (Dato-DXd)—a trophoblast cell surface antigen 2 (TROP2)-directed antibody–drug conjugate—has demonstrated efficacy in patients with advanced nonsquamous non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) ± actionable genomic alterations. However, TROP2 expression by pathologist assessment using conventional immunohistochemistry with visual scoring does not predict response to TROP2-directed antibody–drug conjugates in NSCLC. We developed TROP2 quantitative continuous scoring (QCS)—a fully supervised computational pathology approach that quantifies TROP2 expression in individual NSCLC cells and subcellular components from immunohistochemistry-stained slides. Using QCS to determine TROP2 expression at the tumor cell membrane and cytoplasm, normalized membrane ratio (NMR) was developed (ratio of membrane relative to membrane + cytoplasmic TROP2) in the biomarker-evaluable population of patients with advanced NSCLC in the TROPION-PanTumor01 study (n = 115). The TROP2 NMR cut-point was optimized and validated in patients with nonsquamous NSCLC without actionable genomic alterations (primary intended-use population, n = 221) in the biomarker-evaluable population (n = 352) of the TROPION-Lung01 trial. Association with clinical outcomes was assessed. Progression-free survival was longer in Dato-DXd-treated (median 7.2 versus 4.0 months; hazard ratio 0.40, 95% confidence interval 0.25–0.64) but not docetaxel-treated (median 4.1 versus 4.4 months; hazard ratio 0.94, 95% confidence interval 0.59–1.49) patients with TROP2 NMR-positive versus TROP2 NMR-negative samples (treatment by biomarker status interaction P = 0.0098), indicating that TROP2 NMR may be a predictive biomarker for Dato-DXd.
items.zh_abstract: Datopotamab deruxtecan（Dato-DXd）是一种靶向滋养层细胞表面抗原2（TROP2）的抗体偶联药物，已在晚期非鳞状非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）±可靶向基因组改变患者中显示出疗效。然而，病理学家使用传统免疫组化视觉评分评估的TROP2表达，不能预测NSCLC患者对靶向TROP2的抗体偶联药物的反应。我们开发了TROP2定量连续评分（QCS）——一种全监督计算病理学方法，可从免疫组化染色切片中量化单个NSCLC细胞及亚细胞组分中的TROP2表达。在TROPION-PanTumor01研究（n = 115）的晚期NSCLC生物标志物可评估人群中，使用QCS确定肿瘤细胞膜和细胞质中的TROP2表达，开发了归一化膜比率（NMR）（膜TROP2与膜+细胞质TROP2的比值）。TROP2 NMR临界值在TROPION-Lung01试验的生物标志物可评估人群（n = 352）中，于无可用药基因组改变的非鳞状NSCLC患者（主要预期使用人群，n = 221）中进行了优化和验证。评估了其与临床结局的相关性。在Dato-DXd治疗的患者中，TROP2 NMR阳性样本较TROP2 NMR阴性样本的无进展生存期更长（中位7.2个月 vs 4.0个月；风险比0.40，95%置信区间0.25–0.64），但在多西他赛治疗的患者中并非如此（中位4.1个月 vs 4.4个月；风险比0.94，95%置信区间0.59–1.49）（治疗与生物标志物状态的交互作用P = 0.0098），表明TROP2 NMR可能是Dato-DXd的预测性生物标志物。

items.abstract: Objective quantification of epidermal melanin content and dermal blood volume is crucial for equitable applications in dermatology and in the evaluation and engineering of optical devices, such as pulse oximeters, where variable amounts of melanin may introduce inaccuracies. Here, we demonstrate a method leveraging diffuse reflectance spectroscopy and a machine-learning framework using fully connected neural networks (FCNNs) to non-invasively estimate melanin and blood indices from sparse data through spectral upscaling. We validated the algorithm on custom phantoms, porcine skin, and in vivo human participants. In phantoms with variable blood and melanin (0–20%), the model achieved high accuracy (R2 > 0.90) to absolute concentrations. In porcine skin, estimated melanin strongly correlated with histology-derived density scores (Pearson r = 0.95). Across six regions of the human hand, the FCNN accurately estimated pigmentation from sparse wavelengths, even during hand-raise challenges that induce confounding blood volume changes. After upscaling, sparse-wavelength estimates strongly correlated with a model using over 450 wavelengths (Pearson r = 0.96), reducing data requirements ~ 150-fold without compromising accuracy. These findings highlight the importance of high-spectral information for disentangling melanin and blood contributions in reflectance spectra and the capacity of machine-learning to restore predictive performance from sparse inputs. These findings demonstrate that artificial-intelligence -driven spectral upscaling can enhance objective skin tone quantification in wearable optical devices.
items.zh_abstract: 对表皮黑色素含量和真皮血容量进行客观定量，对于皮肤病学中的公平应用以及光学设备（如脉搏血氧仪）的评估和工程化至关重要，因为不同量的黑色素可能引入不准确性。在此，我们展示一种方法，利用漫反射光谱（diffuse reflectance spectroscopy）和一种使用全连接神经网络（fully connected neural networks, FCNNs）的机器学习框架，通过光谱上采样（spectral upscaling）从稀疏数据中无创估计黑色素和血液指数。我们在定制体模（custom phantoms）、猪皮肤和在体人类参与者中验证了该算法。在血液和黑色素可变（0–20%）的体模中，模型对绝对浓度达到高准确度（R2 > 0.90）。在猪皮肤中，估计的黑色素与组织学衍生的密度评分强相关（Pearson r = 0.95）。在人手六个区域中，FCNN从稀疏波长准确估计色素沉着，即使在诱发混杂血容量变化的抬手挑战（hand-raise challenges）期间也是如此。上采样后，稀疏波长估计与使用超过450个波长的模型强相关（Pearson r = 0.96），在不损害准确性的情况下将数据需求减少约150倍。这些发现突出了高光谱信息在反射光谱中区分黑色素和血液贡献的重要性，以及机器学习从稀疏输入恢复预测性能的能力。这些发现表明，人工智能驱动（artificial-intelligence-driven）的光谱上采样可增强可穿戴光学设备中客观肤色的量化。

items.abstract: [International journal of medical informatics] Perineural invasion (PNI) in tongue squamous cell carcinoma (TSCC) is associated with aggressive behavior and poor outcomes, yet it can be under-recognized on H&E sections because it is often focal and interpretation varies. Manual assessment of PNI suffers from significant interobserver variability, motivating AI-based decision support. We developed and externally validated a weakly supervised WSI model to predict PNI in TSCC. We retrospectively analyzed 1,511 digitized H&E whole-slide images from 629 patients at two centers. Patient-level partitioning yielded an internal training cohort of 305 patients and 787 WSIs, an internal validation cohort of 132 patients and 340 WSIs, and an external test cohort of 192 patients and 384 WSIs. Non-overlapping tiling generated 41,552,500 candidate patches before tissue-background exclusion, of which 7,813,555 unique tissue patches were retained for analysis. A two-stage pipeline was used: patch-level modeling and MIL-based slide aggregation. ResNet50 was selected over Inception_v3 and SimpleViT as the feature extractor. Patch-level prediction probabilities and image features were aggregated into a 101-dimensional patch likelihood histogram (PLH) and a 101-dimensional visual bag-of-words (BoW) representation, respectively. For conventional classifiers, the two representations were concatenated into a 202-dimensional vector, followed by z-score normalization and LASSO feature selection. For the Transformer, the two representations were processed separately using PCA, independently projected into 128-dimensional embedding spaces, and integrated using four-head cross-attention. Performance was assessed by ROC, decision curve analysis (DCA), and calibration. The internal training, internal validation, and external test cohorts included 305, 132, and 192 patients, respectively. PNI prevalence was 82.3%, 79.5%, and 72.9% in these cohorts, respectively. The Transformer fusion model achieved AUCs of 0.990 in the training cohort, 0.968 in the internal validation cohort, and 0.940 in the external test cohort. Calibration and decision curve analysis were used to characterize the model's predicted probabilities and modeled net benefit in the retrospective study cohorts. Patch-level Grad-CAM was used to generate qualitative saliency visualisations associated with ResNet50 patch-level PNI scores. This externally validated computational pathology application demonstrated retrospective technical feasibility for WSI-level PNI predicti
items.zh_abstract: [International journal of medical informatics] 舌鳞状细胞癌（TSCC）中的神经周围侵犯（PNI）与侵袭性行为和不良结局相关，但由于其常为局灶性且判读存在差异，在 H&E 切片上可能被低估。PNI 的人工评估存在显著的观察者间变异，促使采用基于 AI 的决策支持。我们开发并外部验证了一种弱监督 WSI 模型，用于预测 TSCC 中的 PNI。我们回顾性分析了来自两个中心 629 名患者的 1,511 张数字化 H&E 全切片图像（WSI）。患者水平划分得到内部训练队列 305 名患者和 787 张 WSI、内部验证队列 132 名患者和 340 张 WSI，以及外部测试队列 192 名患者和 384 张 WSI。非重叠切块在排除组织-背景前生成 41,552,500 个候选图像块，其中保留 7,813,555 个唯一组织图像块用于分析。采用两阶段流程：图像块级建模和基于 MIL 的切片聚合。选择 ResNet50 而非 Inception_v3 和 SimpleViT 作为特征提取器。图像块级预测概率和图像特征分别聚合为 101 维图像块似然直方图（PLH）和 101 维视觉词袋（BoW）表示。对于传统分类器，两种表示拼接为 202 维向量，随后进行 z-score 归一化和 LASSO 特征选择。对于 Transformer，两种表示分别使用 PCA 处理，独立投影到 128 维嵌入空间，并使用四头交叉注意力进行整合。通过 ROC、决策曲线分析（DCA）和校准评估性能。内部训练、内部验证和外部测试队列分别包括 305、132 和 192 名患者。这些队列中 PNI 患病率分别为 82.3%、79.5% 和 72.9%。Transformer 融合模型在训练队列、内部验证队列和外部测试队列中分别达到 AUC 0.990、0.968 和 0.940。使用校准和决策曲线分析来表征模型在回顾性研究队列中的预测概率和建模净获益。使用图像块级 Grad-CAM 生成与 ResNet50 图像块级 PNI 评分相关的定性显著性可视化。这项经外部验证的计算病理学应用在回顾性研究中证明了 WSI 水平 PNI 预测的技术可行性

items.title: Speak before the reveal: a practical method to protect clinical reasoning from artificial intelligence scribe deskilling, never-skilling, and mis-skilling.

items.abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes are rapidly becoming normalized in clinical practice, yet governance frameworks focus on accuracy, privacy, consent, and medicolegal status. Risks to clinician capabilities have received less attention. Speak before the reveal is a proposed method in which clinicians verbalize critical cognitive steps, such as synthesis and plan, before note generation. Recent work distinguishes deskilling in senior clinicians, never-skilling from premature offload in trainees and mis-skilling, the internalization of AI errors and inappropriate use as sound practice. This Perspective builds on emerging evidence that reasoning before seeing AI output may protect unaided reasoning. Training implementation, evaluation, adherence challenges, validation methodology, and governance strategies for training bodies, health services, and scribe vendors are discussed. Speak before the reveal is a low-cost, testable approach to maintaining clinical reasoning for individuals or organizations. Successful AI scribe adoption requires preserving clinicians' ability to work without AI support.
items.zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 环境人工智能（AI）记录助手（ambient AI scribes）正迅速在临床实践中常态化，然而治理框架却聚焦于准确性、隐私、知情同意和医疗法律地位。对临床医生能力构成的风险受到的关注较少。“先口述后揭示”（Speak before the reveal）是一种提出的方法，即临床医生在生成病历记录之前，口述关键的认知步骤，例如综合分析和计划。近期研究区分了资深临床医生的去技能化（deskilling）、受训者因过早卸载认知任务而从未习得技能（never-skilling），以及错误技能化（mis-skilling）——即将AI错误内化并把不当使用视为可靠实践。本观点文章基于新兴证据，即看到AI输出之前进行推理可能保护无辅助推理能力。文中讨论了培训实施、评估、依从性挑战、验证方法学，以及针对培训机构、卫生服务机构和记录助手供应商的治理策略。“先口述后揭示”是一种低成本、可检验的方法，可帮助个人或组织维持临床推理能力。成功采用AI记录助手需要保留临床医生在没有AI支持时工作的能力。

items.title: Learning health system frameworks and the integration of artificial intelligence and data science in United States health care: a scoping review
items.zh_title: 学习型健康系统框架与AI整合：范围综述
items.summary: 梳理美国54项学习型健康系统框架研究与30项AI/数据科学研究，考察AI如何嵌入此类持续学习体系。
key_points: 纳入54项框架研究，其中44%为概念性改造

items.abstract: Learning Health Systems (LHSs) use routinely collected data to generate evidence that informs practice through continuous learning cycles. Artificial intelligence (AI) and data science may strengthen this model, but how LHS frameworks and AI applications relate remains unclear. We mapped LHS frameworks and their components and examined how AI and data science are integrated. Searches identified U.S.-based, English-language studies published January 2007–August 2025; two reviewers independently screened and extracted data, resolving disagreements by consensus. We included 54 framework studies (24 [44%] conceptual adaptations; 30 [56%] real-world implementations) and 30 AI/data science studies. Five components recurred across the frameworks: data infrastructure and interoperability, governance and stakeholder engagement, learning and improvement cycles, evidence generation and translation, and equity and ethics. Relative to framework studies, AI studies less often addressed governance and stakeholder engagement (17% vs 35%) or equity (13% vs 22%), emphasizing computational over organizational functions. Most AI studies (27/30) focused on the data-to-knowledge phase; only three extended to knowledge-to-practice, and none described practice-to-data feedback with post-deployment outcomes informing model updating. AI applications capture only part of the LHS vision, concentrating on knowledge generation with less attention to the organizational and feedback mechanisms needed to translate insights into practice and sustain learning.
items.zh_abstract: 学习型卫生系统（Learning Health Systems, LHSs）利用常规收集的数据生成证据，通过持续学习循环为实践提供信息。人工智能（AI）和数据科学可能强化这一模式，但LHS框架与AI应用如何关联仍不清楚。我们梳理了LHS框架及其组成部分，并考察AI和数据科学如何被整合。检索识别出2007年1月至2025年8月发表的、基于美国的英语研究；两名评审员独立筛选和提取数据，分歧通过共识解决。我们纳入54项框架研究（24项[44%]为概念性改编；30项[56%]为真实世界实施）和30项AI/数据科学研究。框架中反复出现五个组成部分：数据基础设施与互操作性、治理与利益相关者参与、学习与改进循环、证据生成与转化、公平与伦理。相对于框架研究，AI研究较少涉及治理与利益相关者参与（17% vs 35%）或公平（13% vs 22%），更强调计算功能而非组织功能。大多数AI研究（27/30）集中于数据到知识阶段；仅3项延伸到知识到实践，且无一项描述实践到数据的反馈，即利用部署后结局为模型更新提供信息。AI应用仅捕捉了LHS愿景的一部分，集中于知识生成，对将洞见转化为实践并维持学习所需的组织和反馈机制关注较少。

items.title: Multimodal AI in Oral Cancer: A PRISMA-Guided Systematic Review.

key_points: 多模态在诊断准确性、AUC与生存预测上更优

items.abstract: [Healthcare technology letters] Oral cancer presents significant diagnostic and prognostic challenges, often due to late-stage detection and tumour heterogeneity. Recent advancements in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML), offer promising solutions by integrating multimodal biomedical data. This PRISMA-guided systematic review evaluates over 82 studies from 2015 to 2025 that apply convolutional neural networks, transformers and graph neural networks to oral cancer, using combinations of histopathology, radiology, genomics and clinical data. Results indicate that multimodal AI models consistently outperform unimodal approaches in diagnostic accuracy, AUC and survival prediction. Architectures employing attention mechanisms, graph embedding and fusion transformers demonstrate superior performance in tasks such as early lesion detection and treatment outcome modelling. Despite these advances, challenges persist in generalisability, data standardisation and clinical validation. Multimodal AI thus represents a paradigm shift toward precision oncology in oral cancer, warranting further research focused on interpretability, prospective validation and ethical clinical deployment.
items.zh_abstract: [Healthcare technology letters] 口腔癌常因晚期发现和肿瘤异质性而带来显著的诊断和预后挑战。人工智能（AI）的最新进展，尤其是深度学习（DL）和机器学习（ML），通过整合多模态生物医学数据提供了有前景的解决方案。本项遵循PRISMA指南的系统综述评估了2015年至2025年间超过82项研究，这些研究将卷积神经网络、Transformer和图神经网络应用于口腔癌，并使用组织病理学、影像学、基因组学和临床数据的组合。结果表明，多模态AI模型在诊断准确性、AUC和生存预测方面始终优于单模态方法。采用注意力机制、图嵌入和融合Transformer的架构在早期病变检测和治疗结局建模等任务中表现出更优性能。尽管有这些进展，在泛化性、数据标准化和临床验证方面仍存在挑战。因此，多模态AI代表了口腔癌向精准肿瘤学的范式转变，值得进一步开展聚焦于可解释性、前瞻性验证和伦理临床部署的研究。

items.abstract: Long-term cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk prediction remains a major global clinical priority. This study investigates how much prognostic information full-night polysomnography (PSG) carries after explicitly controlling demographic confounding, and whether combining specialized unimodal representations with continuous fusion mechanisms can effectively leverage it. We adopt a modular framework based on Coupled Mamba for simultaneous cross-modal and temporal fusion, capturing long-range dependencies and dynamic interactions between physiological modalities throughout sleep. With this capability, we assess whether specialized supervised representations from task-specific unimodal encoders offer prognostic value comparable to task-agnostic multimodal self-supervised pre-training. Validated on the Sleep Heart Health Study (SHHS) dataset, our approach achieves performance comparable to or better than current state-of-the-art architectures in the fully supervised, data-abundant regime, although the cardiac channel alone accounts for most of the discriminative signal. More importantly, we show that in the reference dataset chronological age strongly drives survival ranking; when provided as an explicit input, it can create a shortcut that obscures the contribution of PSG-derived physiology. Ultimately, our findings suggest that supervised unimodal experts integrated through a fusion engine provide a flexible pathway for prognostic risk ranking from sleep recordings, while reliable CVD screening will require independent external cohorts and explicit confounder control.
items.zh_abstract: 长期心血管疾病（CVD）风险预测仍然是全球主要的临床优先事项。本研究探讨在明确控制人口学混杂后，整夜多导睡眠图（PSG）携带多少预后信息，以及将专门化的单模态表征与连续融合机制相结合能否有效利用这些信息。我们采用基于 Coupled Mamba 的模块化框架，同时进行跨模态融合和时间融合，捕捉整个睡眠过程中生理模态之间的长程依赖和动态交互。借助这一能力，我们评估来自任务特定单模态编码器的专门化监督表征是否能提供与任务无关的多模态自监督预训练相当的预后价值。在 Sleep Heart Health Study（SHHS）数据集上验证时，我们的方法在完全监督、数据充足的情形下达到与当前最先进架构相当或更好的性能，尽管仅心脏通道就承载了大部分判别信号。更重要的是，我们表明在参考数据集中，实际年龄强烈驱动生存排序；当作为显式输入提供时，它可能形成捷径，掩盖源自 PSG 的生理信息的贡献。最终，我们的研究结果表明，通过融合引擎整合的监督单模态专家为从睡眠记录中进行预后风险排序提供了灵活路径，而可靠的 CVD 筛查将需要独立的外部队列和明确的混杂因素控制。

items.abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) is an important predictive and prognostic biomarker that guides targeted therapy, particularly in breast and gastric cancers. Conventional HER2 assessment using immunohistochemistry (IHC) and fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) is limited by inter-observer variability, heterogeneous expression, and diagnostic complexity. This systematic review and diagnostic meta-analysis followed the PRISMA 2020 guidelines to evaluate Artificial Intelligence-based HER2 assessment. Fifty-one studies were included in the qualitative synthesis and 14 in the diagnostic meta-analysis. Bibliometric analysis, methodological taxonomy, comparative evaluation, and pooled diagnostic performance were assessed, with study quality evaluated using QUADAS-2. AI methodologies have rapidly evolved from conventional machine learning and radiomics to deep learning, Vision Transformers, explainable AI, and multimodal frameworks, with histopathology and Magnetic Resonance Imaging. being the most frequently used modalities. Research activity increased markedly between 2023 and 2025. Pooled sensitivity was 87.8%, specificity was 83.5%, and Summary Receiver Operating Characteristic Area Under the Curve (SROC AUC) was 0.852 (95% CI: 0.801-0.881), indicating promising overall diagnostic performance. Deeks' funnel plot asymmetry test showed no significant evidence of publication bias (p = 0.14). However, heterogeneity warrants cautious interpretation of the pooled estimates. Heterogeneous datasets, limited external validation, and inconsistent evaluation methods remain important barriers to clinical implementation. Future research should emphasize multicenter prospective validation, explainable and multimodal AI, foundation models, federated learning, and evaluation in underexplored malignancies, including gallbladder cancer.

items.abstract: Medical imaging is essential for diagnosing disease, guiding treatment and monitoring patients over time. Although artificial intelligence has advanced image interpretation, existing medical models often address restricted tasks, while general-purpose proprietary models lack access to private clinical imaging required to achieve medical expertise. Developing models that can interpret complex examinations and communicate their findings in the context of clinical decisions remains a major challenge. Here, we show that Neuro-VL, a vision-language model trained on nearly one million neuroimaging studies from routine clinical care, can interpret complete imaging examinations and engage in natural language conversations about their findings. Across internal and international datasets, Neuro-VL outperformed frontier general-purpose and specialized medical models in diagnosing, localizing, and describing abnormalities, as well as generating comprehensive radiology reports. The model also compared serial examinations to assess disease progression and more reliably resisted misleading clinical assumptions than leading frontier models from OpenAI and Google. These results extend health system learning beyond individual predictions to interactive image interpretation and longitudinal disease monitoring. They demonstrate how the collective clinical experience of health systems can be used to develop medical AI with specialized expertise and broad clinical capabilities.
items.zh_abstract: 医学影像对于诊断疾病、指导治疗和长期监测患者至关重要。尽管人工智能推动了图像解读，但现有医学模型通常处理受限任务，而通用专有模型无法获取达到医学专业水平所需的私有临床影像。开发能够解读复杂检查并在临床决策背景下交流其发现的模型仍是一项重大挑战。在此，我们展示Neuro-VL——一个在来自常规临床照护的近100万项神经影像检查上训练的视觉-语言模型——能够解读完整影像检查，并就其发现进行自然语言对话。在内部和国际数据集上，Neuro-VL在诊断、定位和描述异常以及生成全面放射学报告方面优于前沿通用模型和专业医学模型。该模型还比较系列检查以评估疾病进展，并且比来自OpenAI和Google的领先前沿模型更可靠地抵御误导性临床假设。这些结果将卫生系统的学习从个体预测扩展到交互式图像解读和纵向疾病监测。它们表明，卫生系统的集体临床经验可用于开发具有专业专长和广泛临床能力的医学AI。

Stroke care is still limited by fragmented care pathways, non-standardised diagnostic work-up and follow-up, and local, non-interoperable data systems across the pre-hospital, in-hospital and post-hospital settings. UMBRELLA-P is a multicentre, prospective, observational study in 7 university hospitals in 6 European countries (Spain, Italy, Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany and Switzerland). Adults with clinically suspected acute stroke or transient ischemic attack (TIA) are managed according to standard of care. Routine clinical, imaging, laboratory, ECG and patient-reported data are collected, pseudonymised, stored on a dedicated server at each hospital and harmonised to the OMOP Common Data Model. The harmonised data form a federated real-world data platform (U-Platform). On this platform, artificial intelligence (AI) models are trained and validated through federated learning, so that no patient data leave the participating sites. The models aim to predict short- and long-term outcomes, reduce time to treatment, and support diagnosis, triage, discharge, follow-up and secondary prevention. Five clinical sub-studies address pre-hospital triage, fast track to reperfusion, emergent intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) management, TIA/minor stroke, and cardiac evaluation with blood biomarkers. The study is observational. The outputs of the AI models are used for research only and will not influence clinical decisions. Participants are followed for up to 12 months.

items.abstract: [Journal of cardiac failure] Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping cardiovascular medicine by transforming routinely collected clinical data into tools for earlier disease detection and more precise phenotyping. Heart failure (HF) represents a particularly compelling opportunity for AI-driven innovation, as many patients with structural heart disease remain unrecognized and traditional diagnostic frameworks often fail to capture disease heterogeneity. AI-enabled electrocardiogram (ECG) models, including EchoNext and PRESENT-SHD, highlight the potential for scalable opportunistic screening strategies for structural heart disease. Multimodal approaches, using ECGs and echocardiograms, are enabling earlier recognition of specific HF phenotypes, such as transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis. Successful implementation of these technologies will require prospective evaluation, thoughtful workflow integration, and responsible deployment. Early-career cardiologists are uniquely positioned to lead this transformation of AI in clinical medicine, ensuring that AI serves as a tool to augment clinical reasoning and ultimately advances more personalized, patient-centered cardiovascular care.

items.abstract: [JMIR medical informatics] Discharge instructions are an important component of the transition from hospital to home for patients with diabetic kidney disease (DKD), whose care often involves multiple comorbidities, medications, and stage-specific management needs. However, producing complete, accurate, clear, and personalized instructions can be challenging for junior physicians. This study aimed to evaluate whether large language model (LLM) assistance improves the quality of DKD discharge instructions produced by junior physicians and whether its benefits vary according to chronic kidney disease (CKD) stage. The study included 101 hospitalized patients with DKD. Discharge instructions for each patient were initially drafted by a group of junior residents (resident group); subsequently, another group of residents at the same level, with the assistance of DeepSeek-V3.2 (AI-assisted group), generated a separate set of discharge instructions for the same 101 patients, resulting in a total of 202 documents. Four clinical experts, including 2 nephrologists and 2 endocrinologists, independently scored both versions of the discharge instructions using a 5-point Likert scale across 5 dimensions: completeness, accuracy, safety, clarity, and personalization. Interrater reliability was assessed using the intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC). Interrater reliability was excellent in both the resident group (ICC=0.817, 95% CI 0.763-0.864; P .05). The proportion of cases achieving a ≥1-point improvement in overall quality was 99% (100/101; 95% CI 94.6%-100.0%). LLM assistance improved the completeness, clarity, and personalization of DKD discharge instructions generated by junior physicians, with advantages greatest in complex cases. A human-AI collaborative model is a promising approach to reduce documentation burden.
items.zh_abstract: [JMIR medical informatics] 出院指导是糖尿病肾脏病（DKD）患者从医院过渡到家庭的重要环节，这类患者的照护通常涉及多种合并症、多种药物以及针对疾病分期的管理需求。然而，对于低年资医生而言，生成完整、准确、清晰且个体化的出院指导可能具有挑战性。本研究旨在评估大语言模型（LLM）辅助是否能提高低年资医生生成的DKD出院指导质量，以及其获益是否因慢性肾脏病（CKD）分期而异。研究纳入101例住院DKD患者。每例患者的出院指导最初由一组低年资住院医师起草（住院医师组）；随后，另一组同等水平的住院医师在DeepSeek-V3.2辅助下（AI辅助组）为同一101例患者生成另一套出院指导，共产生202份文档。4名临床专家（包括2名肾内科医生和2名内分泌科医生）独立使用5点Likert量表对两版出院指导的5个维度进行评分：完整性、准确性、安全性、清晰性和个体化。评分者间信度采用组内相关系数（ICC）评估。两组评分者间信度均极佳（住院医师组ICC=0.817，95% CI 0.763-0.864；P .05）。总体质量改善达到≥1分的病例比例为99%（100/101；95% CI 94.6%-100.0%）。LLM辅助改善了低年资医生生成的DKD出院指导的完整性、清晰性和个体化程度，且在复杂病例中优势最大。人机协作模式是减轻文书负担的一种有前景的方法。

items.abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] Cerebrovascular diseases remain a major cause of mortality and long-term disability worldwide. Digital subtraction angiography (DSA) provides high-spatiotemporal-resolution visualization of cerebrovascular anatomy and contrast-agent dynamics and plays an important role in diagnosis, interventional treatment planning, and treatment assessment. Artificial intelligence (AI) has increasingly been applied to cerebrovascular DSA, yet the available evidence is distributed across diverse imaging settings, technical tasks, datasets, and validation strategies. This structured topical review provides a DSA-centered overview of AI-assisted cerebrovascular image analysis across 2D DSA, three-dimensional rotational angiography, and four-dimensional DSA. Literature from Web of Science Core Collection and major engineering databases was screened at title, abstract, and full-text levels using predefined eligibility criteria. The literature is organized around six interconnected tasks: image preprocessing, vessel and lesion segmentation, image registration, reconstruction and generation, disease diagnosis and detection, and hemodynamic analysis. Representative conventional and learning-based methods are reviewed together with their datasets, evaluation metrics, validation designs, and available data or code resources, with particular attention to the strength and limitations of the supporting evidence. Recent studies demonstrate increasing use of spatiotemporal modeling, deep learning, and image-generation techniques, but clinical translation remains constrained by small or single-center datasets, heterogeneous acquisition protocols and evaluation practices, limited external and prospective validation, model interpretability, and deployment requirements. Future work should emphasize acquisition-aware and physics-informed modeling, multicenter and privacy-preserving collaboration, clinically meaningful validation, and closer integration with neurointerventional workflows. By linking methodological developments with their supporting evidence and translational challenges, this review aims to support the development of more robust and clinically applicable AI methods for cerebrovascular DSA.
items.zh_abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] 脑血管疾病仍然是全球死亡和长期残疾的主要原因。数字减影血管造影（DSA）可提供脑血管解剖结构和对比剂动力学的高时空分辨率可视化，并在诊断、介入治疗计划和治疗评估中发挥重要作用。人工智能（AI）已越来越多地应用于脑血管 DSA，但现有证据分散于不同的成像环境、技术任务、数据集和验证策略中。这篇结构化专题综述以 DSA 为中心，概述了二维 DSA、三维旋转血管造影和四维 DSA 中 AI 辅助的脑血管图像分析。来自 Web of Science Core Collection 和主要工程数据库的文献使用预定义的合格标准在标题、摘要和全文层面进行筛选。文献围绕六项相互关联的任务进行组织：图像预处理、血管和病灶分割、图像配准、重建与生成、疾病诊断与检测以及血流动力学分析。综述了代表性的传统方法和基于学习的方法及其数据集、评价指标、验证设计以及可获取的数据或代码资源，特别关注支持证据的优势与局限性。近期研究表明，时空建模、深度学习和图像生成技术的使用日益增多，但临床转化仍受限于小型或单中心数据集、异质性采集方案与评价实践、有限的外部验证和前瞻性验证、模型可解释性以及部署要求。未来工作应强调采集感知和物理知情建模、多中心和隐私保护协作、具有临床意义的验证，以及与神经介入工作流程更紧密的结合。通过将方法学进展与其支持证据和转化挑战相联系，本综述旨在支持开发更稳健、更具临床适用性的脑血管 DSA AI 方法。

items.abstract: Current medical benchmarks typically break down clinical competence into isolated factual questions, single-image tasks, or static case vignettes. These tests score individual answers, but reveal less about whether a model can integrate subspecialty knowledge with multimodal evidence and track a patient's condition throughout a course of care. To close this gap, we introduce NPCBench, a clinical apprenticeship benchmark for nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC). NPCBench mirrors specialist training, from guideline and foundational knowledge to case planning, longitudinal review, CarePath integration, and open-ended consultation. It contains 4,777 component and consultation items and a 100-patient CarePath cohort with 417 scored diagnostic and care tasks. The episode-level evaluation tests whether diagnostic and care answers are jointly correct within a care pathway. By linking stepwise tasks to patient-level care trajectories, NPCBench evaluates whether models ground decisions in visual evidence, interpret changes in patient state, and meet clinical requirements in consultation. Across 30 evaluated models, we observe a composition gap: strong performance on individual tasks does not ensure jointly correct diagnostic and care answers for the same patient. Among 21 multimodal models, strict CarePath success reaches at most 23%. Paired controls and physician calibration further examine evidence grounding, longitudinal revision, and consultation judging. Overall, NPCBench broadens the evaluation of medical artificial intelligence beyond static question-answering paradigms to an apprenticeship-oriented assessment of clinical workflows, thereby offering a testbed for evidence-based and temporally coherent reasoning in oncology care.
items.zh_abstract: 当前的医学基准通常将临床能力拆解为孤立的事实性问题、单图像任务或静态病例短述。这些测试对单个答案评分，但较少揭示模型能否将亚专科知识与多模态证据整合，并在整个照护过程中追踪患者病情。为弥合这一差距，我们提出NPCBench，这是一个针对鼻咽癌（nasopharyngeal carcinoma, NPC）的临床学徒制基准。NPCBench模拟专科培训，从指南和基础知识到病例规划、纵向回顾、CarePath整合和开放式咨询。它包含4,777个组成项和咨询条目，以及一个100例患者的CarePath队列，其中包含417项计分的诊断和照护任务。事件层面的评估检验诊断和照护答案在一条照护路径内是否联合正确。通过将分步任务与患者层面的照护轨迹相关联，NPCBench评估模型是否将决策建立在视觉证据上、解释患者状态变化，并在咨询中满足临床要求。在30个被评估模型中，我们观察到一种组合差距：在单项任务上的强劲表现并不能确保对同一患者作出联合正确的诊断和照护答案。在21个多模态模型中，严格的CarePath成功率最高仅为23%。配对对照和医生校准进一步考察证据依据、纵向修订和咨询评判。总体而言，NPCBench将医学人工智能的评估从静态问答范式扩展到以学徒制为导向的临床工作流程评估，从而为肿瘤照护中基于证据和时间连贯的推理提供了一个测试平台。

items.title: PhysioWave-T: Token-Efficient Wavelet Foundation Models for Biosignals

items.summary: 提出面向EEG、ECG、sEMG的令牌高效小波基础模型，压缩序列长度并在多项EEG基准与癫痫检测上超过对照。
key_points: 小波尺度折叠压缩令牌序列
EEG模型30M参数、预训练超15M窗口
9项EEG指标中8项领先，并优于LUNA-L
items.reason: 预印本新方法，大规模预训练与多基线对比，但缺外部临床验证
items.abstract: We present PhysioWave-T, a token-efficient wavelet foundation model family for EEG, ECG, and sEMG. Dynamic scale folding recombines J+1 wavelet subbands prior to tokenization, compressing sequence length from (J+1)CS to CS tokens for J levels, C channels, and S temporal patches. Route-specific front ends and learned channel-name embeddings allow one Transformer per modality to handle diverse montages and sampling rates, while unseen setups reuse the backbone via lightweight adapters. We pre-train a 30M-parameter EEG model on over 15M windows (19--128 channels), alongside ECG (30M) and sEMG (12M) encoders. Across four EEG routes, scale folding cuts Transformer latency by 4.0--7.2x and peak memory by 6.8--12.7x over scale expansion without accuracy loss. Our EEG encoder leads 8 of 9 metrics against BENDR, BIOT, LaBraM, and EEGPT, and surpasses LUNA-L on wearable seizure detection with fewer parameters. Reliability-aware latent fusion (RALF) further integrates summary tokens from independently pre-trained encoders via sample-adaptive weights. On SeizeIT2, RALF raises event sensitivity at 11 false alarms/h from 61.4% to 74.4% and window AUPRC from 0.321 to 0.399 over the best unimodal baseline, outperforming weighted-logit and concatenation fusion across all variants. PhysioWave-T also achieves state-of-the-art sEMG accuracies and top macro-F1 on PTB-XL Super and Chapman-Shaoxing. Code and models: https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/PhysioWave.
items.zh_abstract: 我们提出PhysioWave-T，这是一个面向EEG、ECG和sEMG的令牌高效小波基础模型系列。动态尺度折叠在令牌化之前重组J+1个小波子带，在J个层级、C个通道和S个时间块下，将序列长度从(J+1)CS个令牌压缩至CS个令牌。路由特定的前端和学习到的通道名称嵌入使每种模态的一个Transformer能够处理不同的导联组合和采样率，而未见过的设置可通过轻量级适配器复用主干网络。我们在超过1500万个窗口（19–128个通道）上预训练了一个3000万参数的EEG模型，并同时预训练了ECG（3000万参数）和sEMG（1200万参数）编码器。在四条EEG路径上，与尺度扩展相比，尺度折叠将Transformer延迟降低4.0–7.2倍，峰值内存降低6.8–12.7倍，且不损失准确率。我们的EEG编码器在9项指标中的8项上领先于BENDR、BIOT、LaBraM和EEGPT，并在可穿戴癫痫发作检测中以更少参数超过LUNA-L。可靠性感知潜在融合（RALF）进一步通过样本自适应权重整合来自独立预训练编码器的汇总令牌。在SeizeIT2上，相对于最佳单模态基线，RALF将每小时11次误报下的事件灵敏度从61.4%提高到74.4%，并将窗口AUPRC从0.321提高到0.399，在所有变体中均优于加权logit融合和拼接融合。PhysioWave-T还取得了最先进的sEMG准确率，并在PTB-XL Super和Chapman-Shaoxing上取得最高macro-F1。代码和模型：https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/PhysioWave。

items.abstract: Ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes have moved rapidly from experimental pilots to enterprise-wide deployment across health systems, promising reduced documentation burden and improved clinician experience. While research evaluating these tools has expanded quickly, there are no agreed-upon protocols or standardized metrics for assessing their performance, making it difficult to compare findings or cumulatively synthesize evidence across studies. Across 54 recent evaluation studies, we identify ten evaluation dimensions and 40 distinct metrics, operationalized in 96 different ways-35 of them (36%) used by only a single study. Assessment is dominated by documentation efficiency and time, measured in 44 of 54 studies. The other dimensions appear at broadly similar rates (16-24 studies each), and safety and clinical outcome least consistently of all. Ripple effects on the broader care system, such as impact on patients' care outcomes, redistribution of work, changes in billing and coding intensity, and downstream use of notes by other clinicians are rarely assessed. Moreover, the metrics used rely heavily on self-report and are fragmented and inconsistently operationalized, which limits comparability and hinders synthesis across studies. As an effort to support more rigorous and cumulative evaluation, in this paper we review the study designs, data sources, and metrics commonly used to evaluate ambient AI scribes in healthcare settings, discuss the limitations of current evaluation practice, and argue for a more holistic approach grounded in a standardized, multi-dimensional set of metrics.
items.zh_abstract: 环境人工智能（AI）记录助手已迅速从实验性试点走向卫生系统中的企业级部署，有望减轻文书负担并改善临床医生体验。尽管评估这些工具的研究迅速扩展，但目前尚无公认的方案或标准化指标来评估其性能，这使得比较研究结果或跨研究累积综合证据变得困难。在54项近期评估研究中，我们识别出十个评估维度和40项不同指标，这些指标以96种不同方式操作化——其中35项（36%）仅被一项研究使用。评估以文书效率和时间为主，在54项研究中有44项测量了这些方面。其他维度的出现率大致相似（各16–24项研究），而安全性和临床结局在所有维度中最不一致。对更广泛照护系统的连锁影响，例如对患者照护结局的影响、工作重新分配、计费和编码强度的变化，以及其他临床医生对记录的下游使用，很少被评估。此外，所用指标严重依赖自我报告，且碎片化、操作化不一致，这限制了可比性并阻碍了跨研究的综合。为支持更严谨和累积性的评估，本文综述了医疗环境中评估环境AI记录助手常用的研究设计、数据来源和指标，讨论了当前评估实践的局限性，并主张采用以标准化、多维度指标集为基础的更整体化方法。

items.abstract: Abstract Background: Ambient AI documentation reduces documentation burden and electronic health record (EHR) time for ambulatory clinicians. Newer features also queue orders and offer some level of coding support for clinician review. This study compares two commercial products deployed at UCLA Health. Objective: To compare Nabla and Epic Systems, Inc. ambient AI solution among ambulatory clinicians at UCLA Health on usability, documentation burden, perceived note quality, adoption, EHR time and productivity, clinician-reported experience with order queueing and coding support, coding and billing patterns and integrity, work productivity, and patient-reported communication experience. Methods: Two-arm parallel-group randomized trial, 1:1, among 374 ambulatory clinicians at a single academic health system who hold an active license for a standalone ambient application (Nabla). Randomization is covariate-constrained where cohort size permits, balancing age, sex, half-day clinic sessions, specialty group, and baseline System Usability Scale (SUS) score. Intervention runs 11/9/2026 to 1/17/2027, with the first four weeks as lead-in. The primary outcome is SUS score at follow-up, compared between arms. Analysis is by intention-to-treat using mixed-effects models. Ethics and dissemination: Determined exempt by the UCLA Institutional Review Board (IRB-26-2147). Survey completion indicates consent. No patient-level data are collected. Findings will directly inform operational decision making and will be published regardless of direction.

items.abstract: Structured Electronic Health Records (EHR) models typically treat each clinical concept as a dataset-specific token, discarding the natural-language semantics associated with the event. As a result, relationships between concepts must largely be learned from EHR co-occurrence, without directly exploiting any prior semantic knowledge. We investigate how pretrained causal language models can be adapted for longitudinal EHR prediction by developing tEHR. Here, we represent events with their natural language description and use this text stream to apply EHR-adaptive continued pretraining, followed by task-specific discriminative fine-tuning using LoRA, utilising the LLM as a longitudinal patient-encoder. We evaluate this approach across four prediction tasks on the MIMIC-IV dataset and pancreatic cancer prediction on the CPRD dataset at 1 to 12 month horizons, with tEHR using the Mistral-7B-v0.3 backbone achieving the strongest overall performance. Ablations show that performance declines when clinical descriptions are removed or misaligned, when numerical values are omitted, and when either stage of adaptation is removed, while explicit elapsed-time descriptions provide little additional benefit. Analysis of the learned patient representations further reveals clinically coherent structure associated with distinct patterns of disease risk and clinical history.
items.zh_abstract: 结构化电子健康记录（EHR）模型通常将每个临床概念视为数据集特定的标记（token），丢弃与该事件相关的自然语言语义。因此，概念之间的关系在很大程度上必须从EHR共现中学习，而未直接利用任何先验语义知识。我们通过开发tEHR，研究如何将预训练的因果语言模型适配用于纵向EHR预测。在此，我们用事件的自然语言描述来表示事件，并使用该文本流进行EHR自适应持续预训练，随后使用LoRA进行任务特定的判别式微调，将LLM用作纵向患者编码器。我们在MIMIC-IV数据集上的四项预测任务以及CPRD数据集上的胰腺癌预测（1至12个月预测时程）中评估该方法，其中采用Mistral-7B-v0.3骨干的tEHR取得最强的总体性能。消融实验显示，当临床描述被移除或错位、当数值被省略，以及当任一适配阶段被移除时，性能均下降；而明确经过时间的描述几乎没有额外获益。对学习到的患者表示的分析进一步揭示了与不同疾病风险和临床病史模式相关的临床一致结构。

Accessing and modifying personal data and business invoices. These are just a few examples from the past year of publicly reported systems breaches by artificial intelligence (AI) agents. Such reports have heightened some people's concerns that AI poses an existential threat, with others dismissing such concerns as marketing hype. What is not debatable is that AI agents are rapidly evolving, potentially beyond human containment.

诊断分层后信号减弱但仍存在

items.abstract: The extent to which demographic-associated information is detectable across organs and disease states in routine clinical histopathology remains unclear. Here, we analyzed 1.3 million hematoxylin and eosin whole-slide images from 257,322 patients across 25 organs, using pathology foundation-model representations and multiple-instance learning to systematically map information associated with sex, age group, and self-reported race. Across 69 organ-demographic combinations, demographic attributes were broadly recoverable, with pan-organ mean AUROCs of 0.828 for sex, 0.733 for age group, and 0.662 for self-reported race, and substantial variation across organs. Demographic-class balancing produced relatively small changes in performance, while evaluation within diagnosis-text clusters showed modest attenuation. Under training with diagnosis-based grouping, demographic-associated signals remained detectable across multiple organs, including sex in gastric tissue (AUROC 0.865), age group in breast (0.816), and self-reported race in skin (0.728). Literature-guided analysis of these settings generated candidate histomorphological and contextual explanations for further investigation. Together, these findings provide a systematic map of demographic-associated information in routine histopathology, informing investigations of its sources, assessments of potential shortcut learning, and the development of more interpretable computational pathology models.
items.zh_abstract: 在常规临床组织病理学中，与人口学相关的信息在不同器官和疾病状态下的可检测程度仍不清楚。在此，我们分析了来自25个器官、257,322名患者的130万张苏木精-伊红（hematoxylin and eosin）全切片图像，使用病理基础模型表征和多实例学习，系统映射与性别、年龄组和自我报告种族相关的信息。在69个器官-人口学组合中，人口学属性广泛可恢复，性别、年龄组和自我报告种族的跨器官平均AUROC分别为0.828、0.733和0.662，且不同器官间差异很大。人口学类别平衡对性能产生的变化相对较小，而在诊断文本聚类内评估时显示出轻度衰减。在基于诊断分组进行训练时，人口学相关信号在多个器官中仍可检测到，包括胃组织中的性别（AUROC 0.865）、乳腺中的年龄组（0.816）和皮肤中的自我报告种族（0.728）。对这些情况的文献引导分析产生了候选的组织形态学和情境解释，以供进一步研究。总之，这些发现提供了常规组织病理学中人口学相关信息的系统图谱，为其来源研究、潜在捷径学习的评估以及更具可解释性的计算病理学模型的开发提供了信息。

items.title: Weight-Space Programming for Medical Imaging: Do We Still Need Training Data?
items.zh_title: 医学影像的权重空间编程：不再需要训练数据？
items.summary: 预印本让大模型直接写出医学图像分类器权重，在7个任务4种模态上与零样本MedSigLIP及常规训练模型比较。
key_points: LLM一次回复直接生成LeNet式网络参数
对照零样本MedSigLIP与Adam训练基线
覆盖胸片、乳腺超声、腹部CT与盆腔MRI
items.reason: 预印本方法新颖且有明确基线对比，但仅在公开基准上评估，给6分
items.abstract: Can a large language model (LLM) write the parameters of a medical image classifier from medical knowledge alone, without any training data? Such classifiers normally require labelled images, which are costly and often unavailable. We investigate this question through weight-space programming (WSP), in which an LLM writes or adapts the weights and biases of a neural network directly, without optimisation on training data. Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra each generate the parameters of a small LeNet-style CNN in a single reply, without tool use and without access to any image. We compare these networks against zero-shot MedSigLIP and against the same architecture trained on labels using the Adam optimiser, across 7 classification tasks in four modalities: chest X-ray, breast ultrasound and abdominal CT (all from MedMNIST), and pelvic MRI (SynthUterus). The LLM-written networks perform above chance on all six MedMNIST tasks, with a mean test AUC of 0.719 for Opus and 0.711 for Astra. Both models outperform MedSigLIP on 5 of 6 tasks while using more than 10,000 times fewer parameters. However, the same network trained with Adam on only 256 labelled images achieves a higher AUC on every MedMNIST task (mean AUC 0.828). On SynthUterus, Opus attains an AUC of 0.764, whereas Astra falls below chance (AUC 0.136) owing to a systematic error. These results show that LLMs can write functional medical classifiers, but that they do not yet replace training data. We release the protocol, logs and all generated weights at https://github.com/MaximilianLindholz/weight-space-programming-medical.
items.zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）能否仅凭医学知识、在没有任何训练数据的情况下写出医学图像分类器的参数？此类分类器通常需要标注图像，而标注图像成本高昂且常常不可获得。我们通过权重空间编程（WSP）研究这一问题：在该方法中，LLM 直接写出或调整神经网络的权重与偏置，而不在训练数据上进行优化。Claude Opus 5.5 和 GPT-6 Astra 各自在单次回复中生成一个小型 LeNet 风格 CNN 的参数，不使用工具，也无法访问任何图像。我们在四种模态的 7 个分类任务上，将这些网络与零样本 MedSigLIP 以及使用 Adam 优化器在标签上训练的相同架构进行比较：胸部 X 线、乳腺超声和腹部 CT（均来自 MedMNIST），以及盆腔 MRI（SynthUterus）。LLM 写出的网络在全部六个 MedMNIST 任务上均高于随机水平，Opus 和 Astra 的平均测试 AUC 分别为 0.719 和 0.711。两个模型在 6 个任务中的 5 个上优于 MedSigLIP，同时使用的参数少超过 10,000 倍。然而，相同网络仅使用 256 张标注图像通过 Adam 训练，就在每个 MedMNIST 任务上取得更高的 AUC（平均 AUC 0.828）。在 SynthUterus 上，Opus 达到 AUC 0.764，而 Astra 由于系统性错误而低于随机水平（AUC 0.136）。这些结果表明，LLM 能够写出功能性的医学分类器，但尚不能取代训练数据。我们在 https://github.com/MaximilianLindholz/weight-space-programming-medical 发布协议、日志和所有生成的权重。

items.title: Curiosity-0826-4B: Generative Medical Event Sequence Modeling Across Pediatric and Adult Populations
items.zh_title: 生成式医疗事件序列基础模型Curiosity-0826-4B
items.summary: 基于 Epic Cosmos 训练的生成式医疗事件基础模型更新版，可零样本预测临床事件并扩展至儿科人群。
key_points: 实验室值预测MAE较前版降低18–46%
儿童哮喘新诊断AUROC 0.742–0.785
镰状细胞危象AUROC 0.820–0.847，低于成人0.915
items.reason: 大规模EHR基础模型有基线对比与儿科扩展，但为预印本、评估有限
items.abstract: We introduce Curiosity-0826-4B, an updated version of the generative medical event foundation model trained on Epic Cosmos that simulates patient timelines to produce zero-shot clinical predictions. Curiosity-0826-4B incorporates a broader patient population and richer clinical event representations, while generally matching or exceeding Curiosity-0226-1B, the largest model in the previous Curiosity-0226 series, on evaluated tasks supported by both models. Laboratory value prediction improved, with MAE 18--46% lower than that of Curiosity-0226-1B. We evaluated prediction of disease events across pediatric cohorts aged 2--17 years. AUROCs for new asthma diagnosis (0.742--0.785) and asthma exacerbation (0.829--0.852) were comparable to those in the adult reference cohort, while AUROCs for sickle cell crisis (0.820--0.847) were lower than in adults (0.915). Explicit representation of documented death enabled new mortality prediction tasks among adults across hospice, inpatient, and ambulatory settings (AUROC 0.821--0.942). Scaling-law analysis guided compute-optimal initial pretraining followed by continued pretraining with context extension. The resulting Curiosity-0826-4B model has more parameters (4.3B versus 1B) and a longer context window (16K versus 8K). It processes 56% fewer training tokens and requires 2.2 times the training floating point operations (FLOPs) compared with its predecessor. By extending a common zero-shot prediction strategy to pediatric patients and additional outcomes, Curiosity-0826-4B broadens opportunities to develop clinical and operational applications without training separate task-specific models. Further validation should assess local calibration, performance across patient subgroups and event frequencies, timeline completion rates, and generalization to new settings, alongside prospective evaluation of clinical and operational utility.
items.zh_abstract: 我们介绍了Curiosity-0826-4B，这是在Epic Cosmos上训练的生成式医疗事件基础模型的更新版本，其模拟患者时间线以生成零样本临床预测。Curiosity-0826-4B纳入了更广泛的患者人群和更丰富的临床事件表示，同时在两个模型均支持的受评估任务上，总体达到或超过Curiosity-0226-1B——上一代Curiosity-0226系列中最大的模型。实验室数值预测得到改善，MAE较Curiosity-0226-1B低18–46%。我们在2–17岁的儿科队列中评估了疾病事件的预测。新发哮喘诊断（0.742–0.785）和哮喘加重（0.829–0.852）的AUROC与成人参考队列相当，而镰状细胞危象的AUROC（0.820–0.847）低于成人（0.915）。对已记录死亡的显式表示使得能够在临终关怀、住院和门诊环境中的成人中开展新的死亡预测任务（AUROC 0.821–0.942）。缩放定律分析指导了计算最优的初始预训练，随后进行带有上下文扩展的持续预训练。所得的Curiosity-0826-4B模型具有更多参数（4.3B对1B）和更长的上下文窗口（16K对8K）。与其前代模型相比，它处理的训练token少56%，所需训练浮点运算次数（FLOPs）为2.2倍。通过将一种常见的零样本预测策略扩展到儿科患者和更多结局，Curiosity-0826-4B拓宽了在不训练单独任务特定模型的情况下开发临床和运营应用的机会。进一步验证应评估本地校准、跨患者亚组和事件频率的性能、时间线完成率以及对新环境的泛化能力，同时开展对临床和运营效用的前瞻性评估。

items.title: Reliability-Aware Clinical Relation Learning for Uncertainty-Robust Multi-Label Chest X-ray Classification
items.zh_title: 可靠性感知临床关系学习的胸片多标签分类
items.summary: 预印本提出ReCaRL图辅助框架，用可靠性加权与置信门控处理胸片多标签噪声标注，并做内外部区分评估。
key_points: 以训练标签关联构图，加权门控更新预测
用观测掩码处理不确定标注
与扁平、加权、图与层级惩罚基线对比
items.reason: 含外部区分评估且对比基线充分，但为预印本且细节待同行评审
items.abstract: Background: Automated multi-label classification of chest radiographs is complicated by overlapping imaging findings, noisy report-derived labels, and changes in disease co-occurrence across clinical settings. Existing clinical-hierarchy methods can encode label relationships, but a rigid hierarchy may conflate categorical membership with empirical association and propagate annotation errors. Methods: We investigated Reliability-Aware Clinical Relation Learning (ReCaRL), a graph-assisted framework for multi-label chest radiograph classification. An image encoder produces initial finding scores, while a graph constructed from training-label associations provides reliability-weighted, confidence-gated updates. Uncertain annotations are handled with observation masks. The evaluation compares flat, weighted, graph-based, and hierarchy-penalty baselines, with internal and external discrimination and calibration assessments. Results: In the internal evaluation, ReCaRL achieved macro AUROC 0.821 and macro AUPRC 0.437, compared with 0.812 and 0.423 for the masked/weighted baseline. Mean AUROC across five common findings was 0.865 versus 0.858. External testing yielded AUROC 0.799 and AUPRC 0.409. Post-hoc calibration reduced the internal Brier score from 0.113 to 0.102 and the external expected calibration error from 0.082 to 0.061, without changing AUROC or AUPRC. Conclusions: Reliability-aware graph propagation and confidence gating were associated with modest improvements in multi-label chest radiograph classification relative to the matched masked/weighted baseline. Post-hoc calibration improved probability reliability in the reported evaluations. The findings do not establish a benefit in prospective clinical decision-making.
items.zh_abstract: 【背景】胸部X线片的多标签自动分类因影像表现重叠、报告来源标签有噪声以及不同临床环境中疾病共现情况变化而变得复杂。现有临床层级方法可以编码标签关系，但僵化的层级可能将类别归属与经验性关联混为一谈，并传播标注错误。【方法】我们研究了可靠性感知临床关系学习（Reliability-Aware Clinical Relation Learning，ReCaRL），一种用于多标签胸片分类的图辅助框架。图像编码器生成初始发现评分，而由训练标签关联构建的图提供可靠性加权、置信度门控的更新。不确定标注通过观测掩码处理。评估比较了平坦、加权、基于图和层级惩罚的基线，并进行内部和外部判别与校准评估。【结果】在内部评估中，ReCaRL达到宏AUROC 0.821和宏AUPRC 0.437，而掩码/加权基线为0.812和0.423。五种常见发现的平均AUROC为0.865对0.858。外部测试得到AUROC 0.799和AUPRC 0.409。事后校准将内部Brier评分从0.113降至0.102，并将外部期望校准误差从0.082降至0.061，而未改变AUROC或AUPRC。【结论】相对于匹配的掩码/加权基线，可靠性感知图传播和置信度门控与多标签胸片分类的适度改善相关。事后校准在报告的评估中改善了概率可靠性。这些发现不能确立在前瞻性临床决策中的获益。

items.abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Union Hospital, Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology; conditions: Emergency and Critical Care, Chest Radiography, Diagnostic Error, Thoracic Abnormalities; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: PHASE1; enrollment: 70000; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Chest radiography is widely used in emergency departments, resuscitation rooms, intensive care units, and other acute-care settings. Clinically important abnormalities may be missed because findings are subtle, uncommon, obscured by overlapping anatomy, or encountered under high workload. This pragmatic randomized trial evaluates whether EvoXRare, an artificial intelligence system that provides a draft chest radiograph report and high-risk alerts for uncommon or clinically important abnormalities, reduces clinically important diagnostic misses compared with routine physician interpretation alone. Approximately 70,000 adults will be randomized 1:1 across 15-20 hospitals in China. The primary endpoint is the patient-level rate of clinically important abnormalities present on the reference standard but not reported in the initial clinical interpretation. Key secondary outcomes include detection of rare or easily missed findings, time to recognition of critical abnormalities, report turnaround time, false-positive alerts, additional imaging, recall/communication events, and selected short-term clinical outcomes.
items.zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：华中科技大学同济医学院附属协和医院（Union Hospital, Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology）；疾病/状况：急诊与重症监护、胸部X线摄影、诊断错误、胸部异常；类型：干预性；分期：PHASE1（1期）；入组人数：70000；状态：NOT_YET_RECRUITING（尚未招募）] 胸部X线摄影广泛用于急诊科、复苏室、重症监护病房及其他急性护理环境。由于表现细微、少见、被重叠解剖结构遮挡或在高工作负荷下遇到，临床重要异常可能被遗漏。这项实用性随机试验评估EvoXRare——一种提供胸部X线摄影报告草稿并针对少见或临床重要异常发出高风险警报的人工智能系统——与仅由医生进行常规判读相比，是否减少临床重要诊断遗漏。约70,000名成人将在中国15-20家医院按1:1随机分组。主要终点是参考标准中存在但初始临床判读中未报告的临床重要异常的患者水平发生率。关键次要结局包括少见或易漏诊表现的检出、关键异常识别时间、报告周转时间、假阳性警报、额外影像检查、召回/沟通事件以及选定的短期临床结局。

items.title: Artificial Intelligence in Pulmonary Hypertension: Advancements, Opportunities, and Challenges.

items.abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] Pulmonary hypertension (PH) is a progressive cardiopulmonary disorder associated with high morbidity and mortality. Delayed diagnosis, heterogeneous disease phenotypes, and variable treatment responses remain major clinical challenges. Artificial intelligence (AI), including machine learning and deep learning, has emerged as a promising tool for improving PH management. AI-based models have demonstrated promising performance in screening, diagnosis, classification, risk stratification, and prognosis prediction using multimodal data such as electrocardiography, chest radiography, computed tomography, cardiac magnetic resonance imaging, echocardiography, and electronic health records. Furthermore, AI may support individualized risk assessment, treatment-response prediction, early identification of right ventricular deterioration, and longitudinal remote monitoring. Emerging technologies, including explainable AI, federated learning, large language models, and digital twins, may further advance precision medicine in PH. Despite these advances, data quality, interpretability, privacy, and clinical implementation of AI remain challenges. This review summarizes current applications, opportunities, and challenges of AI in PH and discusses future directions for AI-assisted precision healthcare.
items.zh_abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] 肺动脉高压（pulmonary hypertension，PH）是一种进行性心肺疾病，与高发病率和死亡率相关。诊断延迟、疾病表型异质性和治疗反应差异仍是主要临床挑战。人工智能（artificial intelligence，AI），包括机器学习和深度学习，已成为改善PH管理的有前景工具。基于AI的模型在利用心电图、胸部X线摄影、计算机断层扫描、心脏磁共振成像、超声心动图和电子健康记录等多模态数据进行筛查、诊断、分类、风险分层和预后预测方面已表现出有希望的性能。此外，AI可能支持个体化风险评估、治疗反应预测、右心室恶化的早期识别和纵向远程监测。包括可解释AI、联邦学习、大语言模型和数字孪生在内的新兴技术，可能进一步推进PH的精准医学。尽管有这些进展，数据质量、可解释性、隐私和AI的临床实施仍然是挑战。本综述总结了AI在PH中的当前应用、机遇和挑战，并讨论了AI辅助精准医疗的未来方向。

items.title: AI in the Clinical Documentation Loop: Effects of LLM-Induced Note Bloat and Diagnostic Overcall on Downstream LLMs
items.zh_title: LLM生成病历内容对下游模型的影响
items.summary: 预印本研究考察LLM撰写的病历内容造成的“膨胀”与诊断过度记录，如何影响后续读取同一病历的LLM。
key_points: 区分病历膨胀与临床发现失真两类伪影
以诊断过度记录作为失真案例
提示读写双向闭环带来的部署风险
items.reason: 预印本方法学分析有新意，但证据规模与验证有限
items.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to process medical records for healthcare tasks such as clinical documentation. Because these tools also generate documentation, the relationship is now bidirectional: models both read from and write to the record. Understanding how LLMs behave when reading records that already contain LLM-authored content is therefore critical for their safe deployment. In this study, we examine how LLM-authored content in the medical record affects downstream LLMs that read the same record. We consider two types of LLM-induced artifacts: bloat, in which LLM-generated summaries accumulate in the record and change the length and provenance of its content over time; and distortion, in which LLMs subtly alter clinical findings rather than fabricating facts outright. As a case of distortion, we study diagnostic overcall (documenting an unconfirmed differential diagnosis in the record) and test whether it propagates to the reader LLM's output. Across seven reader models from four families, we find evidence of both effects. First, LLM-generated summary notes modestly but consistently degraded downstream hospital-course generation compared with copy-forward and templated text of matched length. Second, injected overcalls reappeared in downstream outputs at rates that varied by reader model, without detectable changes in standard quality metrics. These findings show the need to monitor AI-generated content in medical records and to account for it when those records are later processed by AI.
items.zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（large language models, LLMs）越来越多地被用于处理医疗记录，以完成临床文档等医疗任务。由于这些工具也会生成文档，这种关系现在是双向的：模型既读取记录，也写入记录。因此，理解LLMs在读取已包含LLM撰写内容的记录时如何表现，对其安全部署至关重要。在本研究中，我们考察医疗记录中由LLM撰写的内容如何影响读取同一记录的下游LLMs。我们考虑两类由LLM引起的伪影：膨胀（bloat），即LLM生成的摘要累积在记录中，并随时间改变其内容的长度和来源；以及失真（distortion），即LLMs微妙地改变临床发现，而不是直接捏造事实。作为失真的一种情况，我们研究诊断过度判定（在记录中记录未经确认的鉴别诊断），并检验其是否会传播到读取该记录的LLM的输出中。在来自四个模型家族的七个读取器模型中，我们发现了两种效应的证据。首先，与匹配长度的复制前移文本和模板化文本相比，LLM生成的摘要记录会适度但持续地降低下游住院病程生成的质量。其次，注入的过度判定以因读取器模型而异的发生率重新出现在下游输出中，而标准质量指标未检测到变化。这些发现表明，需要监测医疗记录中AI生成的内容，并在这些记录随后由AI处理时将其纳入考虑。

items.title: Can General-Purpose Generative AI Supply Training Data for Medical Vision Models? A Multimodal Retrospective Study
items.zh_title: 通用生成式 AI 能否为医学视觉模型提供训练数据
items.summary: 预印本回顾性评估通用图像生成模型合成医学影像用于训练与审计，并在真实数据上外部验证。
key_points: 覆盖胸片、眼底、CT 与颈动脉超声四模态
合成数据模型在真实数据上外部验证
肺炎任务 AUROC 0.877（n=14863）
items.reason: 大样本外部验证加分，但为预印本回顾性研究
items.abstract: Background: Well-annotated, diverse medical imaging datasets remain a major constraint for vision-based medical AI. We evaluated Nano Banana, a general-purpose image generation and editing model, as a source of synthetic medical images for model training, subgroup augmentation, and model auditing. Methods: In this retrospective study across four imaging modalities, chest radiography, fundus photography, and CT models were trained only on synthetic images and externally validated on real-world data against real-data-trained models. Carotid ultrasound models were trained on a private Human Phenotype Project cohort (aged 40-75 years) with and without synthetic augmentation. Clinicians rated image plausibility. Evaluation used AUROC, AUPR, calibration, and decision curve analysis. Findings: Synthetic-only models achieved AUROCs of 0.877 (95% CI 0.843-0.910) for pneumonia (n=14863), 0.963 (0.948-0.975) for retinal detachment (n=1149), and 0.711 (0.600-0.823) for renal calculus (n=4122), comparable to real-data-trained models, but their calibration and net benefit were not consistently more favorable. With mixed synthetic-real training, a carotid ultrasound model produced an ordinal vascular age index that stratified 633 external subjects into subgroups differing in BMI and glucose (both p<0.01), linking vascular aging to cardiometabolic health. To stress-test shortcut learning, editing a moderate tessellated pattern into fundus photographs reduced the true-class probability for central serous chorioretinopathy from 0.996 to 0.822. Clinician-guided editing raised low-quality CT plausibility from 3.10/5 to 4.30/5. Interpretation: Synthetic data can complement real data in model training, subgroup representation, and model testing via controlled editing, but its clinical value should be assessed with calibration, decision curve analysis, and clinician review, not discrimination alone.
items.zh_abstract: 【背景】标注良好且多样化的医学影像数据集仍是基于视觉的医学人工智能的主要制约因素。我们评估了 Nano Banana——一种通用图像生成与编辑模型——作为合成医学图像来源，用于模型训练、亚组增强和模型审计。【方法】在这项回顾性研究中，涵盖四种成像模态；胸部X线摄影、眼底摄影和CT模型仅使用合成图像训练，并在真实世界数据上进行外部验证，与使用真实数据训练的模型进行比较。颈动脉超声模型在一个私有的 Human Phenotype Project 队列（年龄40-75岁）上训练，分别在有和无合成数据增强的条件下进行。临床医生对图像合理性进行评分。评估采用 AUROC、AUPR、校准和决策曲线分析。【结果】仅使用合成数据的模型在肺炎（n=14863）上达到 AUROC 0.877（95% CI 0.843-0.910），在视网膜脱离（n=1149）上为 0.963（0.948-0.975），在肾结石（n=4122）上为 0.711（0.600-0.823），与使用真实数据训练的模型相当，但其校准和净获益并非始终更优。采用合成-真实混合训练时，一个颈动脉超声模型产生了序数血管年龄指数，将633名外部受试者分层为BMI和血糖存在差异的亚组（两者 p<0.01），从而将血管老化与心脏代谢健康联系起来。为对捷径学习进行压力测试，将中等程度的镶嵌状（tessellated）图案编辑进眼底照片，使中心性浆液性脉络膜视网膜病变的真实类别概率从0.996降至0.822。临床医生引导的编辑将低质量CT的合理性从3.10/5提高至4.30/5。【解读】合成数据可在模型训练、亚组代表性和通过受控编辑进行模型测试方面补充真实数据，但其临床价值应通过校准、决策曲线分析和临床医生审查来评估，而不仅仅是判别能力。

items.title: Deep learning screening of otoscopic images for ENT referral: development, validation and deployment of NHREF OtoScan
items.zh_title: NHREF OtoScan：耳镜图像深度学习转诊筛查
items.summary: 预印本报告以转诊决策为目标的耳镜图像深度学习筛查工具，合并三个公开数据集4763张图像进行开发、验证与部署。
key_points: 合并三数据集、划分12个临床类别
统一视野归一化预处理
聚焦非专科医生的转诊决策
items.reason: 多来源图像、面向转诊并已部署，但为预印本且缺前瞻结局，属值得一看档上限
items.abstract: Background. Middle and external ear disease is common and largely treatable, but accurate otoscopic interpretation requires training that is scarce outside specialist ENT services. Published deep learning models for otoscopy report high accuracy, yet most are optimised for closed set classification rather than the referral decision a non specialist actually makes, report uncalibrated probabilities, and do not report the near duplicate controls that video derived otoscopic datasets demand. We developed, validated and deployed a screening aid framed around referral rather than diagnosis. Methods. We merged 4,763 otoscopic images from 16 folders across three public datasets into 12 clinically meaningful classes. Every image was passed through a single field of view normalisation function (crop to the illuminated field, square, resize to 224 px, mask to one fixed circle) shared identically by training and inference, to remove the framing cue that otherwise identifies the source dataset. Because one source is video derived, images were grouped by cosine similarity of generic ImageNet features (threshold 0.93, joined transitively) and whole groups assigned to a single split, giving 3,326 training, 719 validation and 718 test images. A MobileNetV2 backbone initialised from ImageNet was fine tuned from block9expand. Probabilities were averaged over the eight dihedral transforms of each image and temperature scaled. The referral score was one minus the probability of a normal ear, and its threshold was set on the validation abnormal ears as the highest value still meeting a target sensitivity of 97%, applied with an inclusive comparison. Model selection, calibration and threshold were frozen before the test split was scored once. Results. On the 718 held out test images, referral sensitivity was 97.0% (95% CI 95.1 to 98.2) and specificity 75.6% (95% CI 69.4 to 80.8), with AUROC 0.974 for abnormal versus normal; a cluster bootstrap over the 363 similarity groups in the test split widens those intervals to 93.8 99.6% and 66.0 83.4% respectively. Of 501 abnormal ears, 15 were not referred; 11 of these were myringosclerosis and none was cholesteatoma. Twelve class macro F1 was 0.686, balanced accuracy 68.3%, and accuracy 85.0% (86.2% with chronic subtypes merged). Temperature scaling (T = 1.2) reduced expected calibration error from 0.0498 to 0.0430. A low confidence flag fired on 4.0% of test images, separating 87.2% accuracy on unflagged from 31.0% on flagged cases.
items.zh_abstract: 【背景】中耳和外耳疾病常见且大多可治疗，但准确的耳镜判读需要培训，而这类培训在专科耳鼻喉（ENT）服务之外很匮乏。已发表的耳镜深度学习模型报告了高准确率，但大多数针对闭集分类而非非专科医生实际做出的转诊决策进行优化，报告的是未校准概率，并且未报告视频衍生耳镜数据集所要求的近重复对照。我们开发、验证并部署了一种以转诊而非诊断为核心的筛查辅助工具。【方法】我们将来自三个公共数据集、16 个文件夹的 4,763 张耳镜图像合并为 12 个具有临床意义的类别。每张图像均经过同一个视野归一化函数（裁剪至照明区域、方形化、缩放至 224 px、掩膜为一个固定圆形），该函数在训练和推理中完全相同地共享，以去除否则会识别来源数据集的取景线索。由于一个来源是视频衍生的，图像按通用 ImageNet 特征的余弦相似度分组（阈值 0.93，传递式合并），整个组被分配到单一划分，得到 3,326 张训练图像、719 张验证图像和 718 张测试图像。以 ImageNet 初始化的 MobileNetV2 骨干从 block9expand 开始微调。概率对每张图像的八种二面体变换取平均并进行温度缩放。转诊评分为 1 减去正常耳的概率，其阈值在验证集异常耳上设定为仍满足 97% 目标灵敏度的最高值，并采用包含性比较应用。模型选择、校准和阈值在测试划分被一次性评分之前已冻结。【结果】在 718 张留出测试图像上，转诊灵敏度为 97.0%（95% CI 95.1 至 98.2），特异度为 75.6%（95% CI 69.4 至 80.8），异常 versus 正常的 AUROC 为 0.974；对测试划分中 363 个相似性组进行聚类 bootstrap 后，这些区间分别扩大至 93.8 至 99.6% 和 66.0 至 83.4%。在 501 只异常耳中，15 只未被转诊；其中 11 只为鼓膜硬化，无一例为胆脂瘤。十二类宏平均 F1 为 0.686，平衡准确率为 68.3%，准确率为 85.0%（合并慢性亚型后为 86.2%）。温度缩放（T = 1.2）将期望校准误差从 0.0498 降至 0.0430。低置信度标志在 4.0% 的测试图像上触发，将未标志病例的 87.2% 准确率与标志病例的 31.0% 准确率区分开。
